title: Frigate Viewer
serverUrlHint: Frigate URL. Without a scheme, HTTPS is used. Credentials are managed in the viewer panel.
defaultCameraHint: This camera opens first when you click the icon.
selectCamerasHint: Select which cameras appear in the viewer panel:
noCamerasConfigured: Configure your server in Settings, then list and select cameras in this panel.
authFailed: Authentication failed (401). Check your username and password. Note: Frigate's native JWT auth (port 8971) is not supported — use port 5000 or a reverse proxy with Basic Auth.
cannotReachServer: Cannot reach server. Check the URL and ensure Frigate is running.
invalidUrl: Use an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
runtimeUnavailable: A private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is required for camera previews.
snapshotWriteFailed: Could not write the temporary camera image.
keyringFailed: Could not read credentials from the system keyring. Unlock it and reload credentials.
terminalFailed: Could not open a terminal for keyring credentials.
